def transform(grid):
    # A single center marker starts a triangular outward wave. The diagonal 2s
    # form expanding sides; the interior alternating diagonals are 1s.
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next((i for i, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == 2), n // 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            d = abs(c - center)
            if d == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif r >= 3 and (c - r) % 4 == (center - 3) % 4:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
PY
